message.content: {"skills": [{"name": "Over-Capacity Entry Denial with WAIT Fallback", "description": "Resolve an edge-entry capacity conflict deterministically: when approving an ENTER_EDGE request would push an edge above its effective MaxVehicles, deny the request and assign the vehicle a WAIT action at its current node for that tick. Use during the capacity and conflict check phase when a vehicle is queued at a node to enter a full edge.", "prompt": "During the Capacity & Conflict Check Phase, evaluate each ENTER_EDGE request against the target edge's effective MaxVehicles (baseline LaneCount × CapacityPerLane, adjusted by any active incident CapacityMultiplier via floor). If approving the request would exceed MaxVehicles, deny the entry and assign the vehicle WAIT at its current node for that tick. Do not admit the vehicle and do not leave it without an action for the tick.", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "granularity": "micro", "objective": "Deny over-capacity entry and substitute a WAIT action for the tick.", "domain": "traffic simulation rules", "task_family": "conflict resolution", "method_family": "admission denial with fallback action", "stage": "capacity & conflict check phase", "applicable_signals": ["Approving an ENTER_EDGE would exceed MaxVehicles", "A vehicle is waiting at a node to enter a full edge", "Edge occupancy already equals effective MaxVehicles"], "intervention_moves": ["Compute effective MaxVehicles for the target edge (baseline adjusted by active incident multiplier)", "Compare current occupancy plus the requesting vehicle against effective MaxVehicles", "Deny the ENTER_EDGE request when it would exceed the limit", "Assign WAIT at the vehicle's current node for that tick"], "contraindications": ["Edge has available capacity", "Vehicle is not requesting edge entry"], "triggers": ["An ENTER_EDGE request would exceed the edge's effective MaxVehicles", "A vehicle is waiting at a node to enter a full edge", "Capacity and conflict check phase is evaluating an edge-entry request"], "workflow_steps": ["Determine the target edge's effective MaxVehicles, applying any active incident CapacityMultiplier with floor.", "Check current occupancy of the edge plus the requesting vehicle against effective MaxVehicles.", "If the request would exceed MaxVehicles, deny the ENTER_EDGE request.", "Assign the vehicle a WAIT action at its current node for that tick.", "If the request would not exceed MaxVehicles, allow normal admission (out of scope for this skill)."], "constraints": ["Denial must be based on the effective MaxVehicles, not the baseline, when an incident is active.", "The denied vehicle must receive a WAIT action for the tick; it must not be left actionless.", "Apply the check within the Capacity & Conflict Check Phase."], "cautions": ["Ensure the incident CapacityMultiplier is applied with floor before comparing occupancy.", "Do not admit a vehicle that would exceed the limit even if it is the only pending request."], "output_contract": ["Entry denied and vehicle assigned WAIT at its node for the tick."], "examples": [{"input": "Incident I1 on E9 (N4 to N9) with CapacityMultiplier = 0.5; At tick 5, 2 vehicles already on E9; a third vehicle at N4 requests ENTER_EDGE(E9).", "output": "Request denied; the vehicle performs WAIT at N4 for that tick.", "notes": "Approving would exceed effective MaxVehicles = 2."}], "tags": ["capacity", "conflict-resolution", "edge-entry", "admission-control", "wait-fallback", "traffic-simulation"], "confidence": 0.75, "risk_class": "low", "support_ids": ["39b6630e-314c-5414-8c5c-0c28df4a1fd6"], "source_draft_ids": ["bff822b9-3636-5baf-a82f-1d4daca6d488"]}]}
